messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@edgecomms.io>, finance@edgecomms.io
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment path confirmation and signer escalation

Hi Liam / EdgeComms finance team,

Hope you're well — following up on INV-7893 for services delivered in Aug (total: USD 42,300). Invoice attached for your records. Can you confirm the payment path you prefer so we can lock the settlement window? Options we can accept: US ACH (for US entities), SEPA (for EU/IE accounts), or SWIFT wire.

Key asks:
- Please confirm preferred method (ACH / SEPA / Wire) and the remittance reference you'll use (so we can auto-reconcile).
- If wire: we need notice by EOD Tue 2026-09-22 for the payment to arrive within the September settlement batch.
- If ACH/SEPA: please confirm clearing cutoff in your treasury (approx date) so we can set expectations.
- Provide VAT/residency certificate if you need the invoice split or zero-rated treatment.

Attachments: INV-7893.pdf (invoice), Bank_Instructions.pdf (redwood receiving details).

If you prefer to route payment to payments@redwood-inference.com and include INV-7893 as the remittance reference, that speeds reconciliation.

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply so we can avoid a late collection cycle.

Best,
Irene Choi
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
---
Note: If the payment will be split across cost centers, let us know the allocation and the named signer for any partial releases.

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@edgecomms.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: finance@edgecomms.io
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment path confirmation and signer escalation

Hi Irene — thanks for the note and invoice. EdgeComms is based in Ireland; finance prefers SEPA where possible. A few quick points from our side:

- We can pay by SEPA (EUR) or wire (USD) — prefer SEPA to avoid FX where the vendor supports it. Please confirm whether you accept SEPA and if you can provide IBAN + BIC in the bank instructions (we got a PDF but wanted fields clearly listed).
- Our AP team needs a VAT registration copy to confirm tax treatment (we'll attach our PO for reference).
- If partial payments are possible, our approvals team requires a named Redwood signer to accept staged releases; otherwise they will hold until full invoice sign-off.

Attached: PO-4432.pdf (internal PO). We'll aim to issue payment by next week after we confirm IBAN/BIC.

Regards,
Liam
Finance Manager
EdgeComms Ltd.

Hi Liam — looping in on the collection cadence. I'm Marissa (lead, Customer Finance). Appreciate you confirming SEPA — two quick asks to move this to payment: 

1) Please confirm the named approver on your side who will sign off for a staged release (name + title). Without that, AP will hold until full release.
2) If you can commit to SEPA by COB Tue 2026-09-15, we can offer a 1% early-pay credit if funds clear within 10 business days of instruction (we'll show this as a short invoice credit).

If a signer isn't in place and you need a full hold, tell us and we'll set a single settlement date to avoid partial reconciliations. I can approve a partial-release request once I have the approver name in writing.

For convenience I've created a DocuSign envelope if you want the approver to sign acceptance of a staged release: https://docusign.com/envelope/example-id (expires 2026-09-22).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Finance
Redwood Inference
